Title: [LSJ] Echo of harmonies & Stone dog Qs

Messages.Author: Alex
Messages.Body:
#1 Can a vampire that plays EoH at superior burn the polical action
card if they do not meet the traditional requirements for playing the
card?

For example, Democritus plays a Parity Shift. Delilah Monroe plays EoH
at superior. Is Delilah able to burn the Parity Shift and therefore
call the referendum even though she is not a Prince (assuming there is
a legal target on the table)? Is she even allowed to move the card to
herself? Must the card be burned immediately after the first
referendum is completed, or can this card be burned at any time? If a
Cryptic Rider was played after the first referendum, and a vampire
played EoH at superior at the end of the successful political action,
does this new referendum pass automatically?

#2 Does Stone Dog allow gargoyle slaves a way to get around the D
action restriction for not controlling a member of the specified
"owning" clan?

For example, if a Saxum, Camarilla Tremere slave, successfully
equips/recruits/employs (what's the right word?) a Stone Dog, can he
now take the D action to enter combat with another minion (granted by
Stone Dog) even if his controller doesn't control a ready Tremere?

Thanks in advance

Alex

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3eac2586.0112...@posting.google.com>, Alex

<ahar...@yahoo.com> writes:
>#1 Can a vampire that plays EoH at superior burn the polical action
>card if they do not meet the traditional requirements for playing the
>card?

No.

"[MEL] Usable by ready vampire other than the acting minion. Move the
political action card used to call the referendum from your ash heap to
this vampire at the end of the action. This vampire may burn that card
to call the referendum as a +1 stealth political action [if he or she
meets the requirements of that card]."

>#2 Does Stone Dog allow gargoyle slaves a way to get around the D
>action restriction for not controlling a member of the specified
>"owning" clan?

No. It provides them with a new (D) action they can take when they're
allowed to take (D) actions. It doesn't provide them with the ability
to break their usual restriction, however.
